summary: Gives guidelines for writing the IANA Considerations section of RFCs, so IANA knows how to manage the registries of constants and other values a protocol uses. It defines policies for how new values may be assigned. It replaces RFC 2434, is a Best Current Practice, and was replaced by RFC 8126.

eli5.summary: Many rules need numbered lists. This guide tells writers how to ask a record-keeper to hand out those numbers fairly.

questions: how to write an iana considerations section
